newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Newman Overseas plans bid for Denway.
newsitem.headline: Newman Overseas plans bid for Denway.

text.p: Newman Overseas Ltd said on Monday it planned to make a HK$0.465 per share cash offer for Denway Investment Ltd, conditional on completion of a share restructuring between Newman and Denway shareholders.

Newman Overseas said it would acquire a 72.8 percent stake in Denway from Hero China Investments Ltd, a subsidiary of Yue Xiu Enterprises (Holdings) Ltd. The offer price represents a 39.6 percent discount to the closing price of HK$0.77 on January 6, when the shares were suspended.
It is the intention of Newman that Denway remains a listed company.
Newman, whose sole business function is the holding of the Denway stake, is indirectly held by Yue Xiu and Guangzhou Jinda Motors Holdings Enterprises.
Yue Xiu and Guangzhou Jinda Motors were both established as investment companies by the Guangzhou municipal government.

Newman said in the notice that it intends to improve the business outlook of Denway by reducing the company's 60 percent stake in Guangzhou Auto Group and thereby its indirect stake in Guangzhou Peugeot.
At the time of its Hong Kong listing, Denway stated that it would maintain its holding in Guangzhou Peugeot for at least 10 years. The sale of the stake will therefore need stock exchange approval.
Newman will also advance HK$60 million to Denway by way of a shareholder's loan to improve the latter's working capital.

Denway is principally engaged in investment in the automotive and automotive-related components industries in Guangzhou. It owns a 95 percent interest in Guangzhou Auto Group Corp which holds a 46 percent interest in Guangzhou Peugeot, the announcement said.
Denway has reported substantial losses in recent years due in large part to the financial difficulties of Guangzhou Peugeot, the notice said.
